sv.title: Kalibers granskning vinner internationellt pris
sv.summary: P1-programmet Kalibers granskning Diktatorns svenska krigare har vunnit det prestigefulla priset AIB som delas ut av Association for International Broadcasters i London. Granskningen handlar om hur syriska milismän och torterare från Assadregimen söker sig till Sverige.

en.title: Kaliber's investigation wins international prize
en.summary: The P1 programme Kaliber's investigation "Diktatorns svenska krigare" has won the prestigious AIB prize, awarded by the Association for International Broadcasters in London. The investigation deals with how Syrian militiamen and torturers from the Assad regime seek their way to Sweden.
